component.name: Keet
component.summary: Peer-to-Peer encrypted text and video chat

description.p: This is a community package of Keet and not officially supported by Holepunch.
Keet is a zero-server, peer-to-peer chat and video conferencing application. Every message, call, and file transfer on Keet is end-to-end encrypted and directly exchanged between participants.

Powered by the innovative open-source Pear Runtime technology stack, Keet prioritizes privacy. No middlemen, no metadata harvesting, and no surveillance. No phone number or email is required to start chatting.
